title: The Clover

sources.title: Organ Rearranger
markers: | description = Reduce the number you need to roll a [[Critical Hit]] while attacking by 1. This effect can stack. When you roll 2 damage or less, reroll the dice, taking the highest result.

sources.title: True Strike
markers: | description = Gain {{Advantage}} on your next {{Attack Roll}}.

summary: Unobtainable weapon lowers the critical threshold and adds off-hand AC.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial, One-handed, 5 ft melee, Finesse, Light, Dippable. 1d6 Slashing plus Strength or Dexterity. +2 to attack rolls.
fields.Organ Rearranger: Critical threshold reduced by 1, stacking with other reductions, including ranged and spell attack rolls. Melee weapon damage dice rolling 1 or 2 are rerolled, keeping the higher result. Both melee weapons can benefit, while thrown attacks do not.
fields.Off hand: +1 AC when equipped in off hand.
fields.True Strike: Cantrip, Action, concentration for up to 2 turns, once per Short Rest. Gain Advantage on your next attack against the selected target.
fields.Base value: No nominal value is listed in the pinned item source.
fields.Flourish: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Bonus Action, 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Off Balance for 2 turns, granting attackers Advantage and giving the target Disadvantage on STR/DEX checks. Damage or Help clears it.
fields.Lacerate: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon damage. CON save against weapon-action DC +2 or Bleeding for 2 turns, with 2 Slashing at turn start and Disadvantage on CON saves until healed. The condition source lists Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes and most Undead as immune, with Ghasts and Ghouls as exceptions.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
